description: Press a key — Enter to submit, Tab to move on, Escape to dismiss, arrows to move through a list or grid. Optionally focuses an element first. This is the tool for keyboard-driven screens, where clicking the control is not how the application expects to be used.

exact.description: Require the whole text to match rather than a substring.

frame.description: 'main' (default) or a substring of a frame's origin/name. Single-page apps often render the screen you want in a child frame.

key.description: Key name: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, Delete, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Space.

modifiers.description: Held while pressing: shift, ctrl, alt, meta.

nth.description: Which match to use when several qualify, 0-based.

role.description: Narrow the matches to this ARIA role.

selector.description: CSS selector. Descends into open shadow roots. Optional: focuses this element first.

testid.description: Value of a test attribute (data-testid and friends — see the testAttributes setting). Optional: focuses this element first.

text.description: Visible text on the control. Matches the innermost element that carries it, and follows a <label> to its input. Optional: focuses this element first.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the element to become actionable before giving up.

name: ui_press
